name: Enchant Book
description: An inventory resource visibly used by the live enchanting interface to apply an enchantment to a selected coin.
howToGet: Check the latest in-game information for currently active Enchant Book sources before recording a specific method.

name: Accessory Ticket
description: The ticket resource displayed by the live Accessory Gacha and consumed when players perform accessory rolls.
howToGet: Use the acquisition controls shown in the current Accessory Gacha, and check the latest in-game information for other sources.

name: Engraving Scroll
description: An Update 2.5 inventory resource visibly consumed by the Ability Engraving interface when engraving a coin.
howToGet: Check the latest in-game information for currently active Engraving Scroll sources before recording a specific method.

name: Skateboard
description: The standard traversal equipment named in the official Roblox experience description and used to explore station areas.
howToGet: Use the standard skateboard available through the live game controls. Check the current interface if the equip flow changes.

name: VIP Skateboard
description: A VIP traversal variant shown in Update 2.5 gameplay and identified there as a benefit for current and future VIP owners.
location: VIP benefits and player traversal controls
howToGet: Available to qualifying VIP owners according to Update 2.5 gameplay; confirm the current VIP offer in the live game.
